preparedReview.writer: Original note.save command uses this exact expectedRevision and workspace identity; it must not select a later revision from its queue.

monetaryRules: Exact asset identity includes chain/network, native-or-issued/token address identity and original decimals. Display symbols are never grouping keys.
All source amounts enter as original integer or decimal strings according to their original API contract; decimal conversion is exact and rejects excess precision. No floating point aggregation.

Protocol volume sums independently confirmed executed input and output amounts separately by exact asset identity and protocol. Pending/failed quotes and submitted-but-unconfirmed actions remain separate populations.
Mixed-currency and mixed-asset figures do not have an implicit total. No USD value is inferred without an original dated valuation source.
Source transfers, destination transfers and refunds are separate evidence roles. Source-only confirmation cannot increase destination settled volume or an account's destination credit.
Gas/network fees are separate original native-asset movements. Provider fees denominated in the traded asset are classified with original gross/net semantics so an amount is not deducted twice.
Actual original confirmed movement time, provider reported time and locally observed time remain distinct. Unknown economic time is undated, not silently assigned to observation time.
MoneyGram documented Z-labelled timestamps representing US Central are retained as source text and cannot drive dates or chronology without authoritative corrected information.

metrics.denominator: Unique confirmed economic executions, not query, quote or status-observation count.
metrics.unknown: Confirmed transaction without complete decoded amounts is counted but excluded from monetary sums and appears in the amount-coverage exceptions.

metrics.denominator: Distinct original selection/plan decisions in scope, with execution outcomes separately grouped.
metrics.unknown: Missing protocol or explicit selection record remains unknown; auto-discovery responses do not imply a user selected them.

metrics.denominator: Unique confirmed execution with its exact original selected comparable quote and original input/output amounts.
calculations: For exact-input compare confirmed output to expected and minimum output only when original executed input equals selected quoted input; display signed exact output difference and rational basis points.
For exact-output compare confirmed input to quoted input/max input when original confirmed output meets the exact selected output basis.
Ratio basis points retain integer numerator/denominator and explicit display rounding; aggregate only same-asset economically comparable amounts.
metrics.unknown: Missing/changed quote basis, incomplete result or different executed quantity is NOT_COMPARABLE with full original records retained.

metrics.denominator: Distinct source-recorded failed simulation or unavailable-route event with an explicit following proposal/selection link.
metrics.unknown: A change of selected route without an original fallback relationship is a route change, not an invented fallback.

metrics.denominator: The operator's explicit exact account/asset inventory and original dated balance/transfer range.
metrics.bridge: Opening confirmed balance + confirmed credits - confirmed debits - additional confirmed fees = derived closing; compare with the original closing observation for the same authority/range.
metrics.unknown: Missing opening/closing/range or incomplete transfer coverage yields UNRECONCILED with a visible exact known movement subtotal; never a fabricated zero.

sourceCoverage.rule: Report coverage from explicit original pagination/range evidence. An available response or closed local dataset is not automatically a complete provider history.

lifecycle.rule: Preserve original vocabularies and independent evidence. These display categories are derived projections, never replacements for original provider state.

review.semantics: Versioned operator exception decisions tied to the exact source/report basis; later source changes retain old decisions and visibly require renewed review.
review.requirements: An exclusion requires a reason and remains in the source inventory and report counts. Resolution needs retained exact supporting source. No decision changes an original transaction or amount.
